wal.detail: journal_mode must read back as WAL

synchronousFull.detail: synchronous must read back as FULL (2)

busyTimeoutConfigured.detail: busy_timeout must read back as 2500 ms

foreignKeyEnforced.detail: invalid foreign key must reject and roll back

int64BinaryUtf8.detail: int64, UTF-8 text, and arbitrary bytes must round-trip exactly

fts5Tokenizer.detail: unicode61 must cover identifier/path splits, Unicode Spanish, exact phrases, and prefixes

fts5ExternalContentRebuild.detail: external-content FTS rebuild must restore searchable projection

applicationZstd.detail: versioned application Zstd BLOB round-trips while search projection remains uncompressed

transparentCompression.detail: Not selected: bridge deliberately does not expose WCDB transparent field compression because stock raw-SQL/export interoperability is opaque; application Zstd gate passed

backupReopen.detail: checkpoint-close-copy backup must reopen and preserve rows/application codec

reopenAfterCrash.detail: acknowledged commit must recover after SIGKILL with WAL/FULL

busyTimeoutAndCancellation.detail: native deadline must interrupt a blocked writer within a bounded interval

shutdown.detail: shutdown must close the owned handle and library deterministically

lazyImport.detail: module import must not dlopen the configured missing library

capability.reason: Native gates pass only in clean local experimental staging; no production package/cutover was performed
